scheme_name: Gujarat Textile Policy: Assistance to SHG for Job Work (Fiscal Incentives to Labour Intensive Unit)
other_conditions: SHG must have at least 25 female members
Assistance is available only for female workers of the SHG
SHG should be engaged in job work for industrial units
Industrial unit must pay ₹5,000 per month per female worker in addition to job work charges
benefits_summary: Provides ₹5,000 per month per female SHG member as training assistance for 3 months and payroll assistance of up to 25% of job work value, capped at ₹5,000 per month per member for up to 5 years.
